title: Live-Action Look Back Film Wins Student Jury's UNIMED Award at Venice Int'l Film Fest
content: The film opened on September 11 in Japan. GKIDS will release the film in theaters in 2026 in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Ireland. The 79th Cannes International Film Festival showcased the film on May 15. The London Film Festival will screen the film in October.

title: Producer Jeremy Thomas Dies at 77
content: Thomas was a prolific producer and was perhaps best known for producing The Last Emperor film in 1987, for which he won an Oscar for Best Picture. He served as producer for Takashi Miike 's live-action film of Hiroaki Samura 's Blade of the Immortal manga.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Anime Can’t Fix the Biggest Problem With the Ending
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is already in the works, but the anime will take a while before wrapping up the story. The series returned with Season 3 in January this year as part of the Winter 2026 anime lineup, and it followed the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident Arc.
